title: C_c cut-offs approximating Hⁿ(P ∩ B_1(0)) = ω_n from inside and outside
statement: Let n, ℓ ≥ 0, E = Ambient n ℓ = ℝ^{n+ℓ}, P a linear subspace of E with dim P = n, Hⁿ = μHE[n] and ω_n = omega n. (i) For every real a < ω_n there is g ∈ C_c(E, ℝ) with g(y) ≤ 1 for all y, g(y) ≤ 0 whenever |y| > 1, and a < ∫_P g dHⁿ. (ii) For every real b > ω_n there is h ∈ C_c(E, ℝ) with h(y) ≥ 0 for all y, h(y) ≥ 1 whenever |y| ≤ 1, and ∫_P h dHⁿ < b. Here ∫_P is the Bochner integral with respect to Hⁿ⌞P.
lean_statement: ∀ (n ℓ : ℕ) (P : Submodule ℝ (Ambient n ℓ)), Module.finrank ℝ P = n → (∀ a : ℝ, a < omega n → ∃ g : C_c(Ambient n ℓ, ℝ), (∀ y : Ambient n ℓ, g y ≤ 1) ∧ (∀ y : Ambient n ℓ, 1 < ‖y‖ → g y ≤ 0) ∧ a < ∫ y in (P : Set (Ambient n ℓ)), g y ∂μHE[n]) ∧ (∀ b : ℝ, omega n < b → ∃ h : C_c(Ambient n ℓ, ℝ), (∀ y : Ambient n ℓ, 0 ≤ h y) ∧ (∀ y : Ambient n ℓ, ‖y‖ ≤ 1 → 1 ≤ h y) ∧ ∫ y in (P : Set (Ambient n ℓ)), h y ∂μHE[n] < b)
